author: MTA Arts & Design
title: Call for Artists for LIRR Stations
content: Artists, this is your stop! 🚨 Your artwork could become part of New Yorkers’ everyday commute! MTA Arts & Design is looking for artists for the LIRR Bellerose and Floral Park stations. Artists working in all mediums are welcome to apply! 📅 Deadline: November 20, 2026 🔗Submit your portfolio: Link in bio. Tag an artist who needs to see this! ✨ #callforartists #MTAArtsDesign #MTAPublicArt #LIRR #NYCArts Contact method: Link in bio.

author: Gareth Kavanagh
title: Paid Artist Open Call for Paradise Towers 2 Backup Strips
content: Paid artist open call out! Yes, we're looking for new artists for the backup strips on Paradise Towers 2, out this February. Build high for happiness! Submit sequential art samples to info@cutawaycomics.co.uk by November 29th 2026. Contact method: info@cutawaycomics.co.uk

author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content: 🎨 WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! ✨🐾 Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! 🥰 We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! 📓✍️💖 If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! From journals and stickers to washi tapes and pens, let’s make something magical together. ✨ How to apply: 1️⃣ Make sure you're following us [ @young.onion ]! 2️⃣ Drop a comment below with your favorite emoji and tag an artist friend who needs to see this! 👇 3️⃣ Send us a DM with a link to your portfolio or fill out the application form in our bio! 📂✨ You can also mail us info@youngonion.in Can't wait to see your cute art! Let’s create something amazing! 🌸💫 Contact method: info@youngonion.in or DM or form in bio.

author: When the Silent Bird Sings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers and More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ⤵️ We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships. If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: -Name, general location -Position applying for -Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples -Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-) -Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary) -Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work -Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc) -Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use) -Other notable experience / specializations *NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE* ‼️ ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES. ‼️ Contact method: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com
